reviews.title: Great Fan
reviews.comment: The fans work great and are easy to connect. I set them up through Armoury Crate without any difficulty.
reviews.author: Thomas St. Amand

reviews.title: Quality fans
reviews.comment: Nice airflow, bright lighting, a bit loud at full rpm
reviews.author: Charles W.

reviews.title: Great fan!
reviews.comment: Great fan, colorful, good noise level and very powerful.  Bright colors.
reviews.author: Dan

reviews.title: Great cooling but loud
reviews.comment: It comes with no manual for installation but once you figure it out it’s not too hard to install. The fans get very loud especially on startup even after editing the rpm in the bios. The RGB is very bright and easy to see and the cable is long enough for where I installed them which was the top. For this price I would recommend it
reviews.author: Janefrances

reviews.title: Love them!
reviews.comment: Just as expected. No issues at all.
